describes: tax year 2024-25 VAT treatment applied to calendar-year 2024 Supply and Use Tables
method: vat_product_treatment.csv is written by hand from the VAT Act 1994 schedules (provisions as at 1 October 2026, read for their 2024-25 effect): each of the 103 SUT products' domestic sales are split into standard, reduced, zero and exempt shares, by buyer where the law differs (households, other domestic buyers, exports) for households. Rows marked statute have one treatment by law; rows marked assumed carry a share set by judgement and are never tuned to a receipt or relief figure. The four other CSVs are extracted by tools/extract_uk_firm_vat_composition_tables.py from the three files below; none is typed by hand.

sut.edition: Supply and Use Tables, 1997 - 2024 (consistent with UK National Accounts 2026 Blue Book), released October 2026
sut.note: The same workbook as firm_supply_use_2024 (same sha256); re-fetched 26 Nov 2026.
